Configure the correct key for the selected engine:

- SiliconFlow: Dashboard > Settings > TTS API Keys > SiliconFlow API Key

dashboard.title: Dashboard

quick_action.enable_plugin_hint: Enable this plugin to use quick actions

dashboard.import_session_desc:
How to find your SessionID in your browser:
1. Open TikTok.com in your browser and log in
2. Press F12 (or Right-click ? Inspect)
3. Go to the "Application" or "Storage" tab
4. Under "Cookies" ? "https://www.tiktok.com" find "sessionid"
5. Copy the value and paste it below
dashboard.extract_session_help: Use "Extract SessionID" for automatic extraction with saved login, or "Import SessionID" to copy the SessionID directly from your browser (recommended if you encounter login issues or browser security warnings).
dashboard.storage_note_text: Changing the storage location requires an application restart. You can set a custom path (e.g., in Google Drive or OneDrive) for automatic cloud backup.

dashboard.panel_stream_time_explanation: This panel shows how the stream start time was detected. If it shows "Connection Time" instead of a roomInfo field, the API may not be providing stream start time.

dashboard.tikfinity_required_desc: Make sure the TikFinity Desktop App is running and connected to your TikTok account.
